Why join?

◉

Real community

Meet developers, founders, and creators in person — people who build with AI, in your city.

❋

Learn from peers

See how others use Claude and Claude Code in real workflows. Share tips, skills, and lessons learnt.

▲

Ship better work

Get feedback on your projects, find collaborators, and ship higher quality work faster.

⌘

Hands-on sessions

Live workshops, demo nights, and build hours. Learn by doing, not by watching.

Find your community

Four ways we gather, for every kind of builder.

TALK

Conversations

Open-format discussion. Bring questions, compare workflows, talk through what's working. The lowest-pressure way in.

CONNECT

Meetups

Talks, demos, and networking. See what Cape Town builders are shipping with Claude, then go meet them.

BUILD

Workshops

Laptops open, hands on keyboards. Learn by building and leave with something working.

GIVE BACK

Impact Labs

Working sessions that point Claude at real community problems. Ship something that matters in an afternoon.
